subject: English
question_text: What was the role of the Brhmaputra River in Abedin's life?
guide_solution: Zainul Abedin spent most of his childhood near the scenic banks of the Brahmaputra river. It inspired him from his early life and later appeared in many of his paintings. Actually it was a great source of inspiration throughout his career.
